notes: Six-hour agent timeout (override_timeout_sec=21600) on the fixed-QEMU TB2.1 snapshot; a modified evaluation, not a leaderboard-eligible configuration.

bench-run cohort on HF Jobs (Harbor b20373d6) with the published fast-agent-mcp 0.10.43 wheel; GPT-6 Astra (high reasoning) through GitHub Copilot, with fast-agent's stream-idle timeout raised to 300 s (streaming_timeout=300). Zero whole-trial retries; fast-agent's own provider retries apply. Four infrastructure failures (three dropped connections, a sandbox error) were rerun as replacements; the originals are kept as evidence.

Provider blocks: every attempt at break-filter-js-from-html and vulnerable-secret (10 trials) failed on the first model request, when Copilot's WebSocket rejected it (recorded by bench-run as a content-filter failure). Harbor records these as non-zero agent exits, not safety errors, so they score 0 and the safety allowance does not count them. One model-extraction-relu-logits trial ended with AgentSafetyStopError.
Other GPT-6 Astra cohorts (high and medium through the Codex subscription route, medium through Copilot with the default stream timeout) are complete but not shown.

Cost is Harbor's recorded cost at the cohort's configured OpenAI list rates (card-packs pricing catalog, rules gpt-6-astra-standard-short / -long: $10 / $1 / $50 per million input / cached / output tokens; $20 / $2 / $75 above 272k context). The run used GitHub Copilot, so this is a list-price equivalent, not what Copilot billed. Some trials have model calls that reported no usage, so the total is a lower bound.
